matrix.emits_pcm_from_partial_input_reason: The streaming driver emits SPECTROGRAM FRAMES incrementally. The inverse STFT / overlap-add is run ONCE over the assembled spectrogram, so no PCM is produced from partial input. PROTOCOL §10.1 requires exactly that, and §2 / §10.3 stop the claim boundary at a playable PCM block.

stateful_measurement.note: ONE continuous frame-synchronous stateful stream over all 992 frames, state never discarded. The four condition rows slice that single stream; they are NOT four separate stateful decodes at four chunk sizes. **C1 is established at 16 ms / one-frame granularity ONLY.** The chunk condition parameterises the STATELESS NULL: it is the interval at which state is re-initialised.
